title: Author simple Go unit tests for ProjHub MCP security and product-regression behavior

ground_truth_issues.description: Call ping_team_server with shell-style payloads and assert no execution artifacts like uid= or gid= appear, along with a benign control case.
Ensure internal comments are hidden while public comments remain visible for user-key.
Ensure non-admin users cannot see admin/internal project fields while admin users can.
Initialize the MCP server using NewServer and assert it is not nil and does not error.
Ensure unsafe module names are rejected and safe modules like json are accepted.
Ensure user-key cannot update task-beta or see beta reviewer markers.
Call any valid tool (e.g., get_project or search_tasks) and assert the response contains expected fields.
Call any tool and assert that the response completes and returns without errors.
Ensure internal URLs do not leak metadata and public URLs return expected content.
Ensure diagnostic endpoints do not expose sensitive secrets.
Ensure tests are independent and reproducible.
Ensure tests use proper assertions and captured values.
